name: 用户日消费聚合
sql:
INSERT INTO dws.user_daily_agg
SELECT 
    o.user_id,
    o.order_date as dt,
    SUM(o.order_amount) as total_spend
FROM dw.orders o
WHERE o.order_date = '${dt}'
GROUP BY o.user_id, o.order_date

name: 用户等级分布统计
sql:
INSERT INTO dws.user_level_stats
SELECT 
    up.user_level,
    COUNT(1) as level_cnt
FROM dw.user_profile up
GROUP BY up.user_level

name: 高价值用户标签
sql:
INSERT INTO dws.high_value_users
SELECT 
    up.user_id,
    up.user_level,
    uda.total_spend,
    CASE WHEN up.user_level >= 'V4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_high_value
FROM dw.user_profile up
JOIN dws.user_daily_agg uda ON up.user_id = uda.user_id
WHERE uda.dt = '${dt}'

name: 订单日报表
sql:
INSERT INTO ads.order_daily_report
SELECT 
    o.order_date,
    COUNT(o.order_id) as order_cnt,
    SUM(o.order_amount) as total_amount,
    AVG(o.order_amount) as avg_amount
FROM dw.orders o
WHERE o.order_date = '${dt}'
GROUP BY o.order_date
